protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: Store each task outside the repository in one collision-resistant project/task directory. Do not construct canonical paths by hand:

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - The helper normalizes the absolute Git common directory and derives `<sanitized-repository-slug>--<first-12-sha256>` from that identity. All linked worktrees of one local repository resolve the same project ID; unrelated repositories with the same basename do not.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - `TASK_ID` must be 1-80 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, and must start and end with an alphanumeric character. Reject empty values, separators, traversal, control characters, and every value outside that format before path construction.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - `ANALYZE_CONTEXT_STATE_HOME` may override `~/.analyze-context`, but it must be a dedicated directory outside every worktree. The helper rejects task paths that escape the resolved state root.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - Branch and worktree names belong in the context file as metadata. They do not determine the task directory.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - The store is machine-local. Use a reviewed export or `engos-memory-threader` for cross-machine handoff; never commit scratch state automatically.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not fork versioned analysis files for the same task.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Never write canonical analysis state inside a branch, linked worktree, or main checkout.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not treat session end, compaction, branch removal, or worktree removal as completion or cleanup authority.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Use a distinct task ID for each concurrent task. Read only the exact task selected for the current work.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - One task has one writer at a time. Another session may read or resume only after the current writer stops or explicitly hands off ownership.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Treat legacy `.analyze-context-memory/` directories as read-only migration sources. They must remain gitignored and untracked until migrated.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not keep important findings only in chat history.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Mark a task complete only when every TODO checkbox is checked and `insights` contains the final summary.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Completed files may remain on disk. Cleanup is optional, later, and user-approved; hooks must never delete them.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not store secrets, credentials, or unrestricted sensitive source content in analysis state.

protected_invariants.heading: Trigger and Checkpoint Rule
protected_invariants.text: Do not invoke this skill for a quick one-file answer, ordinary code review, or short-lived lookup.

protected_invariants.text: - On `PreCompact` or `PreCompress`, remind the model to update context, todo, and insights before compaction. If the host event is advisory, do not treat it as the only checkpoint guarantee.

protected_invariants.text: - If a host lacks either event, continue with the skill rule; do not emulate it with noisy per-tool hooks.

protected_invariants.heading: Hook Reminders
protected_invariants.text: - Hooks may read paths, validate freshness, or add a reminder. They must not invent findings, mark completion, move files, delete state, or bypass one-writer ownership.

protected_invariants.text: Legacy migration may encounter `<task>-context.md`, `<task>-todo.md`, and `<task>-insights.md`. Map that task name to the selected stable task ID and retain their content in the corresponding canonical files; do not create a second live set.

protected_invariants.heading: Recovery Procedure
protected_invariants.text: 1. Resolve `TASK_DIR` and select the exact task ID. Never infer the current task from the newest timestamp alone.

protected_invariants.heading: Recovery Procedure

protected_invariants.heading: Consolidation Pass
protected_invariants.text: The read-only command reports line/byte counts, missing files, thresholds, and whether a pass is due. It never initializes, rewrites, archives, or trims state. Missing files require recovery, not an assumption that the task is below threshold. A successful command exit means the check ran, not that consolidation occurred.

protected_invariants.heading: Consolidation Pass
protected_invariants.text: 1. Retain one-writer ownership for the entire read/rewrite/verification pass. Record the before counts; read context and insights in full, and consult TODOs for active scope. Do not infer the final position from the latest paragraph alone.

protected_invariants.heading: Consolidation Pass
protected_invariants.text: - `CURRENT STATE`: only durable, still-true facts supported by current verification.

protected_invariants.heading: Consolidation Pass
protected_invariants.text: 5. Compress and reorganize; do not delete substance. Preserve unique findings, corrections, unresolved questions, and decision reversals. Replace repetitive prose with a faithful summary. Before cutting unique detail, verify an existing durable evidence reference and record its exact locator in the retained text. Git history is valid only if that content is actually committed and retrievable there; these external files are not automatically versioned. If no durable trail exists, retain the detail. Do not create extra canonical files, automatically commit scratch state, or silently discard content to satisfy a size cap.

protected_invariants.heading: Consolidation Pass
protected_invariants.text: 7. Read back both files and rerun `consolidate` to capture after counts. Verify summaries begin within the first 20% of each file, evidence remains findable, and active work is preserved. Report measured reduction or explain why retained substance prevents it. If still above threshold, record the residual reason in the active checkpoint and reassess at the next meaningful checkpoint; do not loop or trim automatically.

protected_invariants.heading: Consolidation Pass
protected_invariants.text: Allowed: a deliberate current-state-first rewrite during ongoing work. Forbidden: automatic truncation, silent loss of superseded claims, declaring completion to enable consolidation, or using this pass as cleanup authority. `todo.md` is unaffected by consolidation; its ordinary replace-in-place checkpoint contract still applies.

protected_invariants.heading: Completion and Cleanup
protected_invariants.text: A task is complete only when every checkbox in `<task-id>-todo.md` is checked, `<task-id>-insights.md` contains the final summary and evidence, and `<task-id>-context.md` is marked `complete`. Leave completed files in place unless the user later approves cleanup. Cleanup must target the exact completed task directory and should use a recoverable operation such as Trash.
